pr_title: Update `dags reserialize` command to work with DAG bundle
pr_body:
This PR also changed the `--subdir` arg to --bundle-name.

Closes: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/45336

issue_context.title: Make `dags reserialize` bundle aware
issue_context.body:
### Body

Today, the `dags reserialize` command can just create a new dagbag against the dags folder and sync it. Once we land support for bundles, however, it's not longer that simple.

This command was temporarily disabled in order to makes reviews easier in #45337, so once #42289 is done, we can rebuild this command.

review_comments: Might be worth leaving a comment that examples DAGs are on. Took me a minute to figure out why it'd work.
